name: Burgundy VS Lapis [Operation Short Circuit Vol. 2]
desc:
Burgundy VS Lapis ( BvL ) is a retro themed fast-paced symmetrical 10v10 FPS game, where your main objective is to eliminate the opposing team.
You can press 'M' to change your class, this game offers a variety of classes with mostly unique play styles.
Mobile support is here!

This game is currently in alpha  phase; nothing is final and some content will eventually change. Bugs are to be expected.
